items.question: What preparatory ritual acts must be performed with respect to Gaṇeśvara in this procedure?
premises: A formal resolution must be made first.
Worship must be performed following that resolution.
Gaṇeśvara is the designated object of this worship.
items.inference: The procedure requires first resolving and then worshipping Gaṇeśvara as preparatory acts.
uncertainties: The subsequent main action governed by these preparatory acts is not stated in this verse alone.
